tools.name: get_market
tools.description: The latest called Elliott Wave count for one market, made at its last completed close: the wave in progress, the price that invalidates the count, and for each timeframe (monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, 15-minute) the wave in progress, its target zone and its invalidation price. Returns Markdown, pl

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every covered market (about 100) with its latest called Elliott Wave count in one line, the date of the close it was made at, its invalidation price and a link to its page. Optionally limited to one group.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.descriptionHash: descripchanged or invalidated recently, newest first.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find markets by symbol, name or group, e.g. 'semiconductors', 'yen', 'india'.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_markets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List every market covered (≈100: US and world indices, US and Asian stocks, crypto, FX, rates, commodities) with its latest called Elliott Wave count in one sentence and its invalidation price. Optionally filter by group." → after: "Every covered market (about 100) with its latest called Elliott Wave count in one line, the date of the close it was made at, its invalidation price and a link to its page. Optionally limited to one group."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
